entries.t: <FACE:3A>The Cluster space<NL>station we're off to<WAIT>shows the cave Medabot<NL><PLAYER> found, right?

<FACE:00>Yeah. Murasame Shiden,<NL>who found it with me,<WAIT>is the top Medafighter<NL>in the ranking run by<WAIT>Robattle Research, who<NL>built the Cluster<WAIT>So he told me to have<NL>it studied closely
<FACE:2E>Thanks to that, all of<NL>us got invited to the<WAIT>grand opening of that<NL>"Cluster" space park

<FACE:00>Robattle Research does<NL>more than rankings<WAIT>Part specs, personal<NL>Medafighter data…<WAIT>They study every scrap<NL>of Medabot data<WAIT>It might be a big find<NL>on Medabot secrets<WAIT><FACE:02>They thanked me a lot<NL>for it
<FACE:36><PLAYER>, you're great!<NL><WAIT>You were in the paper<NL>and you're famous!
<FACE:23>(Hmph!)<NL><WAIT>(A bit of luck and now<NL> he's playing hero!)<WAIT>(To outshine me, the<NL> president? Never!)
<FACE:22>(But he won't be so<NL> smug much longer)<WAIT>(Just watch, <PLAYER>!)
<FACE:06>(…But that president<NL> could use a lesson)
<FACE:22>Now then, everyone, no<NL>detours!<WAIT>This is a social<NL>studies trip!<WAIT>We are not here to<NL>have fun!
<FACE:06>That guy bugs me…<NL><WAIT>Ordering us around<NL>like he owns it all
<FACE:36>Hm?<NL><WAIT>He was talking to the<NL>president just now?
<FACE:04>What is this place…?<NL><WAIT>Is it okay to just<NL>walk in?
<FACE:06>You fell for such an<NL>obvious trap, klutz
<FACE:04>(I got rescued, but I<NL> can't feel glad…)
<FACE:06>What are you doing?!<NL><WAIT>I'm going on ahead!
<FACE:3E>Well, see you tomorrow<WAIT><FACE:00>Yeah, see you tomorrow
<FACE:03>My shoelaces are tied<NL>together!<WAIT><FACE:01>Who would do something<NL>so awful?!
<FACE:04>Calling me out to a<NL>place like this…
<FACE:04>Who's this letter<NL>from, I wonder?<WAIT><FACE:02>…Could it really be<NL>from a girl?!
